evidence.detail: R22 fixes rs/gui/b as RuneLiteSkin. Its constructor creates exactly one rs/gui/c instance and assigns it directly to the SubstanceSkin buttonShaper field.
The class extends Substance ClassicButtonShaper and overrides only getCornerRadius(AbstractButton,float), always returning 0.0f.
Returning zero corner radius makes the RuneLite skin's Substance buttons square-cornered; the class owns no unrelated look-and-feel or widget behavior.
Stable lineage places this class as CLIENT_CLASS_000203 directly between R22 RuneLiteLookAndFeel (000202) and RuneLiteSkin (000204), matching the exact skin-helper ownership.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for RuneLiteSkin's zero-corner-radius Substance button shaper.
